983.title: Photos of the week | July 24-30, 2026
983.rawText:
Heard on the Hill

Troy Jackson, Maine Democratic nominee for Senate, speaks after winning the nomination at the Maine Democrats special nominating convention in Bangor, Maine, on Saturday. Jackson will challenge incumbent Sen. Susan Collins, R-Maine. ( Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call )

Posted July 31, 2026 at 3:40pm

Facebook

Twitter

Email

Reddit

While the House was away on summer vacation, the Senate was busy. The late Sen. Lindsey Graham was remembered with a congressional tribute in the Rotunda. Maine Democrats found a new Senate candidate. Dr. Anthony Fauci pleaded the Fifth. And acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s nomination to be attorney general hit a snag. Here are photographs of the action captured by CQ Roll Call photojournalists.

Delegates listen to Troy Jackson, Maine Democratic nominee for Senate, speak after winning the nomination at the Maine Democrats special nominating convention in Bangor, Maine, on Saturday. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)
Jackson attends a campaign event at Food AND Medicine in Brewer, Maine, after winning the party’s nomination on Saturday. Jackson will challenge incumbent Sen. Susan Collins, R-Maine. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)
Sen. Darline Graham, R-S.C., left, wipes away tears as the Armed Forces Body Bearer Team carries the casket of her deceased brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., up the Capitol steps to the congressional tribute in the Rotunda on Tuesday. Sen. Lindsey Graham died on July 11 from an aortic dissection. (Bill Clark/CQ Roll Call)
Sen. Darline Graham, R-S.C., pays respects at the casket of her late brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., during the congressional tribute ceremony in the Capitol Rotunda on Tuesday. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)
Mourners pay respects to the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., during a congressional tribute ceremony in the Capitol Rotunda on Tuesday. (Tom Williams/CQ Roll Call)
The Armed Forces Body Bearer Team carries the flag-draped casket of Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., down the Capitol steps after the congressional tribute in the Rotunda on Tuesday. (Bill Clark/CQ Roll Call)
From left, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is greeted by Sens. Jim Risch, R-Idaho; Roger Wicker, R-Miss.; and Jeanne Shaheen, D-N.H., as he arrives to meet with senators in the Capitol on Tuesday evening. (Bill Clark/CQ Roll Call)
Former Director of the National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases Anthony Fauci arrives for the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee hearing in the Dirksen Senate Office Building on Wednesday. Sen. Roger Marshall, R-Kan., is seated in the audience to the right. (Bill Clark/CQ Roll Call)
Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, nominee to be attorney general, leaves a meeting with Sen. John Curtis, R-Utah, in the Hart Senate Office Building on Wednesday. (Bill Clark/CQ Roll Call)

1124.title: Spurs make Osimhen approach - Monday's gossip
1124.rawText:
Tottenham make an approach for Victor Osimhen, Atletico Madrid consider a move for Manchester City winger Jack Grealish, and Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo has positive talks with Spurs.

Tottenham have made an initial approach worth up to £55m for Galatasaray striker Victor Osimhen, 27, but the Turkish champions are looking for closer to £65m for the Nigerian. (Caught Offside) , external

Newcastle and Brazil midfielder Bruno Guimaraes, 28, is set to have a medical at Arsenal in a deal that will be worth nearly £80m. (Athletic - subscription required) , external

Atletico Madrid are considering a move for Manchester City winger Jack Grealish, with Everton and Aston Villa also exploring a bid for the 30-year-old Englishman. (Sun) , external

Tottenham have held positive talks with Liverpool forward Cody Gakpo, but the Reds have no intention of selling the 26-year-old Dutchman. (Teamtalk) , external

Braga goalkeeper Lukas Hornicek, 24, has completed a medical and is set to join Newcastle after the Czech Republic international's release clause of £25.7m was met. (Mail - subscription required) , external

Hull City are close to an agreement to sign Nice striker Mohamed-Ali Cho, 22, with a transfer fee of about £17m set to secure the French forward. (L' , external Equipe) , external

Chelsea have submitted an improved offer for left-back Pep Chavarria, 28, after Rayo Vallecano responded to the Blues' opening bid of £12.8m by asking for £21.4m for the Spaniard. (Teamtalk) , external

Hull City are close to signing Australia defender Lucas Herrington, 18, from MLS side Colorado Rapids for £17m. (Sun) , external

Real Madrid duo Gonzalo Garcia, 22, and Cesar Palacios, 21, have been having medicals with Fulham after an agreement over permanent moves for the Spanish striker and midfielder were agreed. (Sky Sports) , external

Hull City are set to beat Rangers and Cardiff City to sign Norwegian midfielder Jens Hjerto-Dahl, 20, from Tromso. (Mail - subscription required) , external

1519.title: The Iranian Doom Loop (w/ Robert Parkinson)
1519.rawText:
Playback speed

×

Share post

Share post at current time

0:00

/

Paid episode

The full episode is only available to paid subscribers of The Bulwark

Eric begins with major show news before pivoting to the jackassery of the week with Eliot. They then analyze Trump’s interactions with Bibi Netanyahu and Vladimir Zelensky at Lindsey Graham’s funeral and discuss the ways in which the Iranian and Ukrainian wars are increasingly intertwined. The two discuss Iran’s ongoing unwillingness to “take yes for an answer” as evidenced by their recent strikes across the region. Historian and Professor Robert Parkinson then joins the show to discuss his recent book Tyrants and Rogues: Understanding the Declaration of Independence. Parkinson explains his focus on the twenty-seven colonial grievances listed in the Declaration, the crown’s misjudgments in attempting to address colonial discontent, and Thomas Jefferson’s additional two grievances that were edited out--among other topics.

Greg Jaffe & Kate Kelly in the New York Times on Adm. Daryl Caudle:

https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/26/us/politics/caudle-navy-hegseth-parlatore-promotion.html
